title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Severely Punishing Illegal Publishing Criminal Activities in Accordance with the Law
full_text_en:
Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Severely Punishing Illegal Publication Criminal Activities According to Law

Fa (Yan) Fa [1987] No. 33

The High People's Courts and People's Procuratorates of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court and Military Procuratorate of the People's Liberation Army:

After the issuance of the Notice of the State Council on Strictly Cracking Down on Illegal Publication Activities on July 6, 1987, public security, industrial and commercial, publishing, cultural, and audio-visual departments in various localities have successively investigated and seized large quantities of illegal publications. Such illegal publications flood the market, seriously endangering market order. At the same time, many illegal publications have decadent content, which is very harmful to the physical and mental health of the masses, especially young people. Some illegal publication activities are serious in nature and violate the criminal law, and criminal liability should be pursued according to law. In order to clarify the legal basis for handling such cases and to severely punish illegal publication criminal activities according to law, the following notice is hereby issued:

1. Those who engage in the publication, printing, distribution, or sale of illegal publications for the purpose of seeking exorbitant profits, where the amount of illegal business or illegal gains is relatively large and the circumstances are serious, shall be punished according to Article 117 of the Criminal Law for the crime of speculation and profiteering. Where the amount is huge, Article 118 of the Criminal Law shall apply. Where the circumstances are especially serious, the provisions of Article 1(1) of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress Regarding the Severe Punishment of Criminals Who Seriously Sabotage the Economy shall apply.

2. Those who engage in the publication, printing, distribution, or sale of pornographic books, pictures, or obscene audio-visual products for the purpose of profit shall be punished according to Article 170 of the Criminal Law for the crime of producing and selling pornographic books and pictures. Where the amount of illegal business or illegal gains is huge or the circumstances are serious, such conduct not only violates the crime of producing and selling pornographic books and pictures, but also violates the crime of speculation and profiteering, and shall be punished as the crime of speculation and profiteering.

November 27, 1987
